speech.text: 10 weird things you didn't know about Ariana Grande. First off, when Ariana Grande was only 13 years old, her own mom thought that she would grow up to be a serial killer. But Ariana Grande later admitted that she was fascinated by serial killers. She even said that if she could have dinner with anyone dead or alive, she would choose Jeffrey Dahmer. Next, every Halloween, she would literally decorate the house with real animal organs from the butcher. And in 2015, security cameras caught Ariana Grande's secretly licking donuts that she hadn't bought inside a donut shop. Next, she intended to tattoo seven rings. But the character she got actually referred to a small Japanese charcoal grill. Next, she hates heights but loves roller coasters. She even once bought a $16 million mansion in Hollywood and reportedly never actually lived there before selling it. Even weirder, she once said she hates being photographed from the right side because she thinks her left side is her good side. Speaking of looks, she has three wisdom teeth and was getting them removed one at a time. Follow for more weird facts.
